title: RunRecord
description: Canonical telemetry record for one exp-runner agent run. Generalized from the L1-L4 harness: task_id/env_id patterns relaxed, repo + model surfaced, env_id fixed to 'asis'. VERSION 2 adds the Workspace Uptake & Retention fields (condition.factors, the six sha256 stamps, backend/model/cli_version, run.matrix_seed/cell_index/run_order_index, tokens.accounting_version, and the WUR artifact paths under raw). Every v2 addition is OPTIONAL, so a v1 record written by the context-ladder harness still validates unchanged; `schema_version` says which generation produced it and NOTHING may be pooled across generations without checking tokens.accounting_version.

schema_version.description: "1" = the context-ladder record. "2" = the same record plus the WUR extensions below.

experiment.description: v2. Which instrument produced this row. figures.py refuses to plot rather than plotting zeros when it does not recognize the pair (experiment, schema_version).

matrix_seed.description: v2. The job-level seed behind the blocked randomisation in schedule.json. Note the probe cadence is NOT seeded from this — cadence.schedule() is seeded by (salt, task_id, rep) only, deliberately not by arm, so probe timing is a matched covariate across arms.

cell_index.description: v2. Index of this (task, arm, rep) cell within schedule.json.

run_order_index.description: v2. Position in the realized launch order — the covariate for any drift over the ~36 h matrix.

concurrency_at_launch.description: v2. How many runs were in flight when this one started (JOBS <= 4 verified, S3).

env_id.description: Ladder: E0..E6. WUR: the arm id (d2, ctrl, d1-np, ...).

condition_id.description: The ARM, under its explicit v2 name; `env_id` keeps the historical ladder spelling and carries the same value, because report.py, figures.py and viz/server.py all read that one. telemetry.py has emitted this since v2, but it was never declared here — so with additionalProperties:false EVERY run printed `['condition']: Additional properties are not allowed ('condition_id' was unexpected)`. An always-on warning is the state in which a real one goes unread.

base_repo_sha.description: WUR: the POST-overlay baseline commit, so injected context never appears in git.patch.

backend.description: v2. claude | codex | gemini | agy — the resolver key, distinct from the model id (job.yaml agent.backend).

model.description: v2. The concrete model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5. Sonnet 5 emits ~30% more tokens than Sonnet 4.6 for the same text, so no historical baseline sizes a run without rescaling.

cli_version.description: v2. e.g. "2.1.222". Findings are about one CLI version on one date; a bump mid-experiment can change the transcript format under the extractor.

factors.description: v2. The WUR arm decomposed into its design factors, so figures and parquet do not have to parse the arm id.

cli_argv_sha256.description: v2. Hash of the exact argv the child was launched with.

probe_text_sha256.description: v2. Hash of the PROBE_TEXT TEMPLATE (with {probe_id} unresolved) — the rendered instance differs per probe by construction. protocol.frozen_hashes() emits it.

pacing_prompt_sha256.description: v2. Reference value 0a687ddfc2f3374378188c2aacde2b5f5d2d97504a63e27dc88a8b9cfcbe249b (338 chars, verbatim, no trailing newline). A different value means the invariant everything rests on was edited.

workspace_sha256.description: v2. Hash of the planted baseline tree.

init_sha256.description: v2. Hash of a CANONICALIZED system/init with cwd, memory_paths, session_id and uuid removed — those four vary every run, and hashing the raw event defeats its own purpose. Verified identical across 4 runs.

canary_sha256.description: v2. Hash of the per-(job, arm) autoload canary answer — the out-of-band verification for d0-push, whose auto-loaded content is invisible in every log.

accounting_version.description: v2, and the reason this whole version exists. per_line_v1 = extract/core.py summed usage per transcript LINE, and Claude Code writes one line per content block with a byte-identical usage: input inflated 1.00x-4.90x (median 1.50x, pooled 2.09x) and output 1.00x-8.72x (median 1.94x) over 116 transcripts. per_message_v2 = deduped by message.id, which was measured to equal the terminal result.usage totals EXACTLY. Records of different versions must NEVER be pooled — including the existing context-ladder results, which are affected. Absent means per_line_v1 by construction.

result_input.description: v2. input + cache_read + cache_creation from the terminal `result` event — the ground truth the deduped sum must equal.

result_output.description: v2. output_tokens from the terminal `result` event.

dedupe_delta_input.description: v2. deduped_total_input - result_input. The pilot gate is exact equality; recording the delta makes a regression of the V7 fix visible instead of silent.

cost_usd.description: v2. result.total_cost_usd — the instrument's own cost, measured rather than modelled.

message_count.description: Transcript/stream LINES, not messages. Measured up to 13.67x the distinct-message-id count — use turns_total for anything that means 'turns'.

turns_total.description: v2. Distinct assistant message.id count. Assistant-only: user lines carry no message.id, so this is not 'all messages'.

tool_calls_task.description: v2. tool_calls_total EXCLUDING probe turns — the difficulty-band metric. This is what events.jsonl is_probe_turn exists for.

resumes_sent.description: v2. RESUME_TEXT injections (capped at 3 consecutive, sent identically in the no-probe arms).

permission_denials.description: v2. len(result.permission_denials). A denied call is retried by the model and then succeeds, costing two barrier fires.

max_tool_uses_per_message.description: v2. The pacing invariant, counted per distinct message.id — never per stream line, which would inherit the V7 bug. Pilot gate: == 1 in >= 95% of runs.

token_curve.description: [[seq, cumulative_input_tokens], ...] sampled at each assistant message

raw.description: Pointers to the immutable layer-1 artifacts. Raw before derived: every derived table can be rebuilt from these months later after a scanner bugfix.

transcript_path.description: WUR: copied BY --session-id, never by newest-mtime, and load-bearing — it is the only source of truncation information.

hygiene_path.description: v2. preflight H1..H12, fail-closed, no API call.

probe_plan_path.description: v2. The seeded cadence, written BEFORE the child starts so it survives a dead run.

gate_path.description: v2. gate/tool_calls.jsonl — the authoritative barrier ordering.

use_detect_path.description: v2. Detector output, produced BEFORE anything else touches the tree (grading mutates the workspace).

persisted_dir.description: v2. Copies of persistedOutputPath files — what the model did NOT see. Never counted as exposure.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256, or null on a v1 record. Everything the model saw is hashed, so a silent edit invalidates cross-run comparison loudly instead of quietly.
